Old, unclean food
Feb 2024 • Friends
Don't waste your time and money, don't go to this restaurant.

The restaurant looks beautiful from the outside, but inside the tables are old, unclean, and the table mats are old and worn.

The grilled meat vermicelli and banh hoi dish was cold, the meat was old, cold, and dry.

Stir-fried eel with lemongrass only has lemongrass and a few pieces of crushed eel and bones. We complained to the manager but he never apologized or offered compensation.

Reheated old braised shrimp dish, full of grease.

The food was so bad that we only took a few bites and left most of it behind.

The invoice was also wrong, a cup of ginger tea cost 15,000 VND, the price was 29,000 VND, we asked to adjust the price, the restaurant had to deduct it from the invoice.
